body:
Founder real-time: pivot MIXFORGE into a multiplayer DJ room, up to 4 DJs queueing YouTube songs, real DJ primitives, cruise-ship/youtube-proxy framing. Named the real prior art (Turntable.fm) including its own real ASCAP/BMI licensing shutdown -- directly load-bearing given this doc's already-deferred licensing stance. Named 3 new requirement classes: room/seat multiplayer state, synchronized room-wide audio playback (promotes Phase 5 streaming from last to a near-term blocker), and clarified youtube-proxy against the already-shipped local-download import pipeline. Real, undecided architecture question named: reuse SHANKPIT's proven multiplayer-room engine vs a new web UI. No code shipped. Commit 313fa3e, pushed.

title: Scoped: multiplayer DJ-room pivot (Turntable.fm-shaped)
